exposure: thoughts and feelings after antenatal appointments and birth
feelings of confidence in themselves and providers
supportive relationship with a health care provider
cohort: Eleven women who had previously experienced a caesarean section and were planning a VBAC in their current pregnancy in Australia.
finding: When women have high feelings of control and confidence, a supportive continual relationship with a health care provider, and are able to have an active labour, it can result in feelings of resolution regardless of the mode of birth.
mod_finding: Feelings of resolution after birth can be achieved regardless of the mode of birth (VBAC or repeat caesarean).
